all_candidates.topic: Should e-commerce platforms face harsher penalties for complaints?
all_candidates.news_anchor: A report on August 14, 2026, revealed nearly 20 lakh consumer complaints against e-commerce platforms in five years, mainly for non-delivery and wrong products.

all_candidates.topic: Is ₹12 lakh nil income tax sufficient middle-class relief?
all_candidates.news_anchor: An August 17, 2026 report highlighted that under the new tax regime, individuals with income up to ₹12 lakh pay no income tax.

all_candidates.topic: Should all city PG accommodations be mandatory inspected?
all_candidates.news_anchor: Following a Delhi building collapse on September 7, 2026, the Delhi High Court ordered an inspection of all city PG hostels within a week.

all_candidates.topic: Is India's Q4 hiring outlook truly optimistic for all job seekers?
all_candidates.news_anchor: A survey released on September 8, 2026, found India's hiring outlook for Q4 2026 to be the most optimistic globally.

all_candidates.topic: Are tech company PIPs leading to unfair layoffs in India?
all_candidates.news_anchor: On September 1, 2026, it was reported that Microsoft put 500 employees on PIPs and Oracle planned 3,000 job cuts in India.

all_candidates.topic: Should NEET protest FIRs always be quashed?
all_candidates.news_anchor: The Supreme Court quashed FIRs against NEET-UG protesters on September 1, 2026.

all_candidates.topic: Should a nominal MDR be applied to some UPI merchant payments?
all_candidates.news_anchor: A bill passed on August 9, 2026, opened discussions for a potential nominal Merchant Discount Rate (MDR) on certain UPI merchant transactions.

all_candidates.topic: Does the DPDP Act sufficiently protect individual digital privacy?
all_candidates.news_anchor: The Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act, effective August 31, 2026, aims to protect citizen privacy with penalties for data misuse.

all_candidates.topic: Are bank employee strikes justified for a five-day week?
all_candidates.news_anchor: The United Forum of Bank Unions announced strikes for September 11 and 28-30, 2026, demanding a five-day banking week.

all_candidates.topic: Are new UPI daily balance check limits user-friendly?
all_candidates.news_anchor: New UPI rules from August 1, 2026, limit daily bank balance checks to 50 times per app.

all_candidates.topic: Should CBSE continue with its digital exam marking system?
all_candidates.news_anchor: In June 2026, top education bosses were removed after marking failures with a new digital system affected thousands of students.

all_candidates.topic: Is the revamped National Consumer Helpline effective for all grievances?
all_candidates.news_anchor: The Department of Consumer Affairs revamped the National Consumer Helpline on September 3, 2026, offering redressal in 17 languages, 7 days a week.

all_candidates.topic: Should new draft petroleum rules prioritize consumer or industry needs?
all_candidates.news_anchor: The Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas notified the Draft Petroleum (Amendment) Rules, 2026, on September 4, 2026.

all_candidates.topic: Is current petrol price stability beneficial for consumers?
all_candidates.news_anchor: Petrol prices in India remained stable at ₹111.21 per litre as of September 8, 2026, with minor fluctuations over the last 10 days.

all_candidates.topic: Is the government ban impacting online gaming jobs fairly?
all_candidates.news_anchor: The online gaming industry began layoffs in 2026 following a government ban on real money gaming.

all_candidates.topic: Are platforms doing enough to label AI-generated content?
all_candidates.news_anchor: New IT rules requiring social media platforms to label deepfakes and AI-generated content came into effect in India on February 20, 2026.

all_candidates.topic: Are recent GST updates genuinely easing business compliance?
all_candidates.news_anchor: Various GST updates were announced on September 7, 2026, aiming to simplify tax filing and invoice management for businesses.

all_candidates.topic: Will PM E-DRIVE amendments truly accelerate EV adoption?
all_candidates.news_anchor: On September 4, 2026, the Ministry of Heavy Industries notified amendments to the PM E-DRIVE Scheme for e-buses and e-trucks.

all_candidates.topic: Should CKYC 2.0 prioritize data security over user convenience?
all_candidates.news_anchor: On September 4, 2026, CKYC issued a circular regarding the readiness for Go-Live of Central KYC Records Registry 2.0 and pilot testing.

all_candidates.topic: Will Semicon 2.0 boost India's chip manufacturing significantly?
all_candidates.news_anchor: The government notified the ₹1,27,500-crore Semicon 2.0 policy on September 1, 2026, with incentives for the semiconductor ecosystem.
